'''2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase Finals Andy Talaga DS''' is the Dark Side deck [[Andy Talaga]] played in the Final of the [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]], which he won.<ref name="ssb">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85450 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase 2025], Domestique, forum.starwarsccg.org (decklists added 3 May 2025); attachment decklists.zip, file FCMain-D-andytalaga.txt. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160258/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85450.html Internet Archive]</ref>
